title: MoveTestPanel: after api.move throws, Move stays disabled and the rejection escapes
evidence: Found 2026-11-25: closed PR 1781's pin P3 (api.move throws) fails on main. widget-src/src/components/MoveTestPanel.tsx:177 sets saving, :180 awaits api.move, and a throw skips setSaving(false) (:181), so Move and Cancel stay disabled (:193-194) and press() (called as void press()) leaves the rejection unhandled. Remedy: the panel's mode as one union whose save step settles on a throw, with P3 as the failing test first. Fixed as PR 2056 fixed the Lp(a) check: press() catches a rejection from api.move as the error outcome, so the panel says the existing words SAVE_ERRORS.error and frees Move and Cancel (widget-src/src/components/MoveTestPanel.tsx); US-04 AC5c; test MoveTestPanel.test.tsx "a move that throws gives Move and Cancel back" failed on main, passes. The panel's saving flag stays a boolean beside the plan: the union remains open work.
